step3_detection_threshold_simulation.purpose: Estimate the minimum detectable prompt-accuracy improvement (in percentage points) under two designs: 3a unpaired (challenger scored on a different sample) and 3b paired (challenger scored on the same calls as v6).
step3_detection_threshold_simulation.detection_rule: An improvement X is 'detected' in a resample if the resample's 95% ticker-block-bootstrap interval for the (challenger - v6) difference excludes zero.
step3_detection_threshold_simulation.detection_threshold_rule: Minimum detectable improvement = smallest X point in the sweep whose detection rate (share of resamples where interval excludes zero) is >= 80%.
step3_detection_threshold_simulation.unpaired_method: Synthesize a challenger population by independently re-flipping v6's per-call hit/miss outcome with probability chosen so that the challenger's expected accuracy is v6's accuracy + X points, preserving each call's ticker label. Resample tickers with replacement from v6 and the synthetic challenger independently (two independent ticker-block bootstraps), compute the difference in resampled hit rates each trial.
step3_detection_threshold_simulation.paired_method: Model the challenger as agreeing with v6 on a modeled disagreement rate d (default 0.15, swept 0.05-0.30 per Step 3's stated-assumption requirement) and, on disagreement calls, right/wrong assigned so that the challenger's net accuracy is v6's + X points. Resample tickers with replacement (single resample draws both v6 and challenger outcomes for the same calls, preserving pairing), compute the per-resample mean paired difference and its ticker-block CI.
